title: React v2 deployment: build React app and serve from FastAPI at /app-v2/ alongside existing /app/ — gradual migration path
goal: Configure the build pipeline so the React v2 app is built and served by the FastAPI server alongside the existing vanilla JS app. REQUIRES all backlog-268 through 275 completed. (1) BUILD SCRIPT: Add to scripts/build_ui_v2.sh: cd ui-v2 && npm run build. The Vite build outputs to ui-v2/dist/. (2) FASTAPI MOUNTING: In api/app/main.py, add a new StaticFiles mount: app.mount('/app-v2', StaticFiles(directory='ui-v2/dist', html=True), name='ui-v2'). This makes the React app available at http://localhost:8000/app-v2/. The existing vanilla JS app remains at /app/ unchanged. (3) VITE BASE URL: Set base: '/app-v2/' in ui-v2/vite.config.ts so all asset URLs are correct when served from /app-v2/. (4) API PROXY IN PRODUCTION: The React app calls /api/* which is already on the same origin (FastAPI), so no proxy needed in production. Remove the vite proxy from backlog-268 once this deployment works. (5) INDEX.HTML CATCHALL: For React Router to work on direct page loads, add a route in FastAPI: @router.get('/app-v2/{path:path}') that returns the index.html file. (6) HEALTH CHECK: Add GET /app-v2/health endpoint that returns { status: 'ok', version: 'v2' }. (7) CI BUILD: Update scripts/run_ui_fast_tests.sh to also run: cd ui-v2 && npm run build && echo 'v2 build OK'. (8) TOPBAR SWITCHER: Add a small 'Switch to v2 UI' link in the existing vanilla JS topbar that opens /app-v2/ in the same tab. Add 'Switch to classic UI' link in the React v2 topbar that opens /app/. This allows gradual migration: users can switch between the two UIs. (9) SHARED COOKIES/AUTH: Both UIs use the same X-Actor header (from localStorage key 'aegispt-actor'). Make the React v2 app read this same localStorage key on startup so actor identity persists between UI switches.
scope: Deploy React v2 alongside existing UI. Both UIs available simultaneously. Gradual migration path.
generation_reason: React v2 must be deployable and accessible before it can replace the old UI. Gradual migration via side-by-side deployment.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Deployment configuration only. No screen changes in this task.
constraints.never_remove_old_ui: The /app/ route and old vanilla JS UI must remain fully functional. This task adds /app-v2/, it does not remove /app/.

success_criteria: npm run build in ui-v2/ produces dist/ directory.
FastAPI serves React v2 at http://localhost:8000/app-v2/.
React Router works on direct page load of /app-v2/findings.
Old /app/ route continues to work unchanged.
'Switch to v2 UI' link in old topbar.
'Switch to classic UI' link in new topbar.
Actor name persists from localStorage between UI switches.
